# Dimensions

Namespace `Nfty.Core.Model` in assembly `Nfty.Ticket`.

```csharp
public record Dimensions
```

Canvas size in pixels. Held by the CookBook and the single source of truth for the whole book: every variant image in every nested Recipe is validated against it, so a Set cannot contain two assets of different sizes.
